_comment: Claude Desktop. Config file: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows %APPDATA%/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. Replace k_YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY with the key issued to you. If you hold a service-token pair instead, swap the Authorization header for CF-Access-Client-Id and CF-Access-Client-Secret. The Add-custom-connector dialog takes a URL and no headers - there, paste https://kirk-mcp.kavara.ai/mcp/k_YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY instead.
